title: PRD — Abhyas
summary: Product Requirements Document for Abhyas, defining core vision, target users, functional requirements (FR-001 to FR-033), non-functional requirements (NFR-001 to NFR-025), AI requirements (AI-001 to AI-020), user personas, journeys, and privacy invariants.
notes: Highest authority document in the precedence hierarchy: PRD > architecture > design > phases.
